help.title: Help
help.sample.replace: The sample replaces the current model. Unsaved changes will be lost.
help.sample.opened: Sample opened: a two-storey house. Switch the level or open 3D
tut.title: First steps
tut.ui.title: Interface
tut.ui.1: Open the command palette: Ctrl+K. Find any command by its name there.
tut.walls.title: Walls
tut.walls.1: Turn on the Wall tool (highlighted on the ribbon) or type WA.
tut.walls.2: Draw 4 walls: click the corners on the plan. Type a length, e.g. 6000 and Enter.
tut.walls.4: Click any wall to select it — its properties open on the right.
tut.openings.title: Doors and windows
tut.openings.2: Place a door: hover a wall and click. Space flips the swing.
tut.rooms.title: A room and undo
tut.rooms.1: Turn on Wall by room outline.
tut.rooms.2: Drag a rectangle in an empty part of the plan — you get 4 walls.
tut.levels.title: Levels and a roof
tut.levels.1: Add a level: give it a name and an elevation, e.g. 3000.
tut.levels.2: Build a roof: click around the building outline and close it.
tut.docs.title: Dimensions and views
tut.docs.1: Place a dimension: pick two points or a wall.
tut.docs.2: Create a section: draw the section line across the building.
tut.docs.3: Place a tag: click a door, a window or a room.
